keyEvents.text: Henry Roy Hearn (AFC Hornchurch) Substitution at 12'
Goal! Hornchurch 1, Blackpool 0. Henry Hearn (Hornchurch) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Angelo Balanta.
Goal! Hornchurch 1, Blackpool 1. Jordan Brown (Blackpool) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner following a set piece situation.
Myles Weston (Hornchurch) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Charlie Pegrum (Hornchurch) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
